description: In the first booth on the right after the entry tunnel, a vintage poster hangs on the wall. A tiny classic Hidden Mickey is drawn above the poster's text, between the words for the month and the events.

whereToLook.scene: First booth on the right after the entry tunnel
whereToLook.exactSpot: The poster. Look just above the printed text, between the month and the word for events.

bestTip: Ask for that booth, or peek in on the way to yours.

viewing.notes: A speakeasy-style restaurant. Reservations get you in; walk-ups at the bar are sometimes possible.
